messages:
Priya K: Seeing p95 spike to 3.2s and a bunch of 502/gateway timeouts on /v1/rerank for customer acct ACME when they hit ~650 QPS with batched inputs.
Marco L: Thanks — can you paste sample payload + X-Request-Id from logs?
Priya K: Curl from customer's repro:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query":"Find best product","candidates":["...large array of 150 items..."],"top_k":5}'
```

Priya K: One X-Req-Id: rq_0a1b2c3d
Support Bot: Alert: rerank-gateway-high-p95 triggered for cluster-rerank-prod at 2142460000
Jane M: Are they sending candidates as one big array (no batching per candidate)? That could blow KV cache and OOM/KV evictions -> timeouts.
Marco L: Logs (snippet):

```
ERR gateway timeout 502 host=re-rank-01 backend=runtimex status=504 retries=2 time_ms=3200 rq_id=rq_0a1b2c3d
WARN kvcache miss rate spiked to 0.82
```

Oncall ML: @Marco can you check model variant quantization and max_sequence? High seq length + 150 candidates kills token processing.
Marco L: Model is rwd-mini-v1-q4f, seq_len avg 512 for candidates, kvcache pressure high. Also saw retry loop on gateway side: client retries immediately causing bursts.
Priya K: Customer says their library retries on 5xx by default with no jitter.
Jane M: Immediate mitigations:
- ask customer to cap candidates to 50
- reduce client retry policy (exponential backoff + jitter)
- enable per-request concurrency limits in gateway
Marco L: Engineering follow-ups: increase rerank pool by 2 replicas, add circuit breaker on backend 5xx, add per-account candidate cap in gateway config.
Oncall ML: For repro, Priya can you share seed script? I can spin up a load generator with candidate_count=150, concurrency=200, batch_size=32 and run trace.
Priya K: Pushing repro script to tmp: /tmp/acme-repro-2142460000.sh
Support Bot: Escalation created: INC-7891 assigned to Eng Runtime
Marco L: I'll open runtime PR to add soft limit and early reject with 400 when candidate_count > 100 for now (config flaggable).
Jane M: Also adding metric alert for kvcache miss rate >0.5 to catch early.
Priya K: Customer notified of temporary mitigation (cap to 50 + retry backoff). Will confirm impact and update.
Oncall ML: Thanks — moving to eng-runtime for deeper root cause. :thumbsup:
